purpose: Mac kapalıyken çalışan, önce yalnız Gamechangers iç taleplerinde insan onaylı kıdemli müşteri temsilcisi akışı

architecture.reason_for_two_entrypoints: Tek işçi ve küçük kontrol yüzeyi. IAP ile insan girişi, Scheduler Jobs API çağrısından ayrılır; varsayılan IAP OAuth istemcisinin programmatic OIDC sınırlaması için yeni OAuth giriş sistemi gerekmez.
architecture.source_packaging: Explicit file allowlist, secret scan, immutable digest; no work/private-connections, .env.local, Keychain, raw mail, evidence archive or development caches in build context.

grants.scope: each of the three named Hamle secrets only
Gmail refresh record only; Basecamp only if rotating OAuth fallback is selected

proposed_service_accounts.name: hamle-control
proposed_service_accounts.purpose: Authenticated human review and durable stop
proposed_service_accounts.limit: Firestore server IAM scopes the database, not individual collections; endpoint code must enforce control/proposal-only mutations.

proposed_service_accounts.name: hamle-scheduler
proposed_service_accounts.purpose: Start the fixed worker job only

managed_identity_and_human_access.application_verification: Validate IAP signed assertion issuer, signature, audience and expiration; require exact allowed email and stable subject. Do not trust a plain email header or browser-supplied actor string.
managed_identity_and_human_access.csrf: Same-origin POST with server nonce; no mutation on GET; exact action/proposal digest and generation required.

secrets.existing_source: MacKeychainStore.load() validated record; read source only in this preparation
secrets.safe_import: After authorized cloud transfer: read native Keychain into memory, validate record and exact identity, add secret version directly by Secret Manager API, log only secret version resource and verification status.
secrets.refresh_behavior: Persist replacement record safely before mailbox action. Never output token, client secret, raw record or HTTP diagnostic. Fail closed if credential update is not durable.
secrets.client_secret_rotation: Previously screenshot-exposed client secret remains a pending rotation item; identify the used secret before changing it, do not disable an arbitrary existing secret.

secrets.preferred_cloud_credential: Separate Hamle personal access token, if this account offers it; provision through provider UI and ingest into Secret Manager without conversation, command-line argument or log exposure.
secrets.fallback: Separate cloud-only Hamle OAuth login, shared rotating refresh record, Firestore credential lock/fencing and atomic version pointer. Stop on uncertain refresh persistence; require reauthorization rather than token replay.
secrets.reason: Official installed CLI v0.13.0 documents refresh-token rotation and session revocation if independent copies reuse replaced refresh tokens.
secrets.provider_scope_limit: Provider credential may reach more than one project; application allowlist 5898865/49184053 is mandatory and must not be described as provider-enforced project scope.

secrets.existing_source: Private .env.local; contents were not read during this preparation
secrets.safe_import: Use existing authorized dedicated key if still suitable; memory-to-Secret-Manager transfer, no plaintext output. Do not create another key merely for deployment.
secrets.first_inference: Passed one customer-data-free Astra/max case: 1251 input, 4064 output tokens (3338 reasoning); estimated token cost 0.21571 USD, not invoice. Its 1 USD hold remains until reconciliation. No business action was authorized by the output.

flow: Read durable control and budget policy before provider access; claim one scheduled slot transactionally.
Verify live Gmail identity and exact scopes; read only Hamle mailbox in explicitly enabled internal scope. Record source message IDs/hash, not a fabricated authoritative order.
Check actual latest observed sender, exact To/CC, auto-reply/self-mail, allowlisted source and duplicate key. Attachments require explicit bounded reader and cannot silently be marked inspected.

Run fixed Astra/max to propose request summary, missing questions, draft reply, brief, task and next follow-up. Model has no direct write tool or secret. Treat mail and attachments as untrusted source content.
Persist proposal with source fingerprint, action digest, control generation and cost reservation. Human sees exact recipient, reply, Basecamp destination and task in authenticated panel.
Human approves only this immutable internal proposal. Stop/takeover transaction increments generation and cancels all pending proposals/actions; resume does not resurrect them.

Immediately before each effect, reread source and control, reverify identity/project/membership/visibility/authorization/approval age, then atomically reserve action and mark dispatch_started. No external API inside retryable Firestore transaction.
Perform one non-retrying provider write outside transaction. Save provider receipt; read created resource back. Timeout/crash/unknown result remains held for reconciliation and never auto-resends.
Poll known internal task/revision status, propose next response or follow-up, and show human audit. Morning summary is a separately deduplicated send after first successful 08:30 slot.

dispatch_limits.E04_policy: Customer scope remains shadow/review-only. A fresh read of Hamle mailbox cannot prove a later unseen CC removal. Visible cloud stop alone does not solve E04; delayed customer actions need an agreed visible authorization/renewal procedure before opening that scope.
dispatch_limits.takeover_limit: A stop cancels pending work. A request already handed to Gmail/Basecamp may complete; show in-flight/unknown state and do not promise recall.

schedule.authentication: OAuth from hamle-scheduler; not OIDC to an IAP panel
schedule.duplicate_delivery_gate: Firestore slot key plus action ledger; Scheduler or Jobs at-least-once effects must not create duplicate actions.

budget.prepaid_accounting: The whole 10 USD purchase counts against the shared 50 USD. Consumption funded by that prepaid balance is not counted against the aggregate a second time; track remaining credits and reservation allocations separately.
required_controls: One shared Firestore budget ledger; transfer existing reservation and baseline exactly once, never reset on cloud deployment.
Reserve bounded infrastructure and model maximums before calls; hold unknown outcomes; reconcile provider actuals without double counting.
Check current time before each new model/provider action; stop new operations at deadline and bound already-started work with shorter request timeouts.
Before enabling recurring triggers, implement and verify a cloud-side expiry shutdown that pauses both named schedules before the deadline; it must work with the Mac off.
Export audit and address remaining service/storage/registry/Scheduler charges at shutdown; an application deadline, paused job or billing alert is not a provider-wide hard cap.

deployment_order: Finish provider adapters, Firestore action/control/budget implementation and immutable proposal approval; test failure cases locally.
Resolve exact scoped credential-transfer/IAM consent; confirm new billing balance and reserve infrastructure maximum.
Create proposed resources only after checking names for existing resources; keep worker control stopped and schedules paused. Never expand probe identities.
Transfer secrets privately, deploy one pinned image, verify cloud-only provider identities and read-only internal permissions.
Open IAP panel as Ahmet from browser; verify durable stop and access denial for unauthenticated caller.
Run bounded customer-data-free Astra/max call, then one internal complete flow with explicit exact-output approval and unique action IDs.
Verify write/readback, stop during queued work, duplicate handling and independent follow-up while local worker is off.
Install verified deadline shutdown and shared budget reconciliation; enable internal schedule only within remaining authorization.
Historical shadow work; then separately accept routine customer scopes after E04, service/brand/contact/revision authority is resolved.

human_steps.plain_language: Kullanıcı üç bağlantının Secret Manager'a aktarımını, dört dar hizmet hesabını ve yalnız Ahmet'e açık paneli açıkça onayladı; ortak 50 USD değişmedi.
human_steps.why_new: New explicit approval supersedes the earlier synthetic-only identity limitation for these proposed resources; it does not expand old probe identities.

human_steps.plain_language: Gerekirse Basecamp'in açacağımız resmî sayfasında Hamle olarak tek bir yeni bulut erişimini onayla; şifre/token paylaşma.
human_steps.why_new: Mac'teki dönen OAuth oturumunu kopyalamak uygun değil; PAT availability or separate login is not yet verified.

human_steps.plain_language: 10 USD kredi ödendi; otomatik yükleme kapatıldı ve doğrulandı. Bu ödeme ortak 50 USD içindedir.

human_steps.when: one actual proposal and full outputs are visible
human_steps.plain_language: Hazırlanan yanıtı ve görevi kontrol ekranında görüp tek iş için onayla; sonra Mac kapalıyken takip ve durdurmayı birlikte doğrulayalım.
human_steps.why_new: User should approve a concrete reviewable output; existing test read is not authorization to resend old test mail.

human_steps.when: internal flow passes, before customer launch
human_steps.plain_language: Her marka için doğru proje/kişiler/hizmet/revizyon sınırını ve Hamle görünmüyorken işi durdurma kuralını tamamlayacağız. Cansu/Özge adreslerini tahmin etmeyeceğim.
human_steps.why_new: Real missing operational inputs, not repeated technical permission.
